subject: Another binding issue with nested uiOutput

messages.author: 2db96e7a0cd6ece6
messages.subject: Another binding issue with nested uiOutput
parts:
I've found another issue with the bindings in nested uiOutput, but I'm having a bit of trouble coming up with a simple reproducible example. Here's the gist of it, though:

Given an app with the following structure

uiOutput(
  sidebarPanel(...)
  mainPanel(
    uiOutput(...)
  )
)

As soon as an output (not an input) is created inside the inner uiOutput, it breaks some dynamically generated inputs in the sidebarPanel. However, the following structure doesn't exhibit the issue:

uiOutput(
  sidebarPanel(...)
  mainPanel(...)
)

This format comes with its own issues for me, though.

I'll keep working on an actual runnable example, but hopefully this might be enough to track down the problem.

messages.author: 2db96e7a0cd6ece6
messages.subject: Re: Another binding issue with nested uiOutput
parts:
After messing around a bit I tried this format:

uiOutput(
  sidebarPanel(
    uiOutput(...)
  )
  mainPanel(
    uiOutput(...)
  )
)

Once an output was created in the mainPanel's uiOutput, the entire uiOutput in the sidebarPanel stopped updating, although the dynamic buttons within the uiOutput did run their reactives. I'm guessing the creation of the output is somehow breaking other reactives at the same level?
